TpSessionTable.description: Descriptor of the J1939 transport-protocol session table, located at 0x20002970 in VCU_0159.

fields.name: entries
fields.description: Base address of the session array (36 bytes per session; 0x200022E0 in this build).

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of sessions in the array (5 in this build, set by proto_sessions_init).

fields.name: callbacks
fields.description: Address of the callback block: accept function word at +0, transmit callback at +0x0C.

CanTxFrame.description: 20-byte CAN frame record: the transmit queue entries at 0x200029AC and the scratch frame at 0x2000297C use this layout (read by can_message_transmit).

fields.name: std_id
fields.description: Standard 11-bit identifier, used when ide is 0.

fields.name: ext_id
fields.description: 29-bit extended identifier, used when ide is 1.

fields.name: ide
fields.description: Identifier type: 0 = standard frame, 1 = extended frame.

fields.name: rtr
fields.description: Remote-frame flag in bit 0 (the code always writes 0).

fields.name: dlc
fields.description: Data length code in the low nibble (0 to 8 bytes of payload).

fields.name: data
fields.description: Payload bytes 0 to 7 of the frame.
